Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for awarding academic credit for military training.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to awarding academic credit for military training;and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Before December 31, 2014, each institution of higher educationmust adopt a policy to award academic credit to an individual who: (a) Is enrolled in the institution of higher education; (b) Has successfully completed any military training course orprogram as part of his or her military service that is: (i) Recommended for credit by a national higher educationassociation that provides credit recommendations for military trainingcourses and programs; (ii) Included in the individual's military transcript issued by anybranch of the armed services; or (iii) Any other documentation of military training or experience;and (c) That is substantially equivalent to any course or programoffered by the institution of higher education. p. 1 HB 1858 (2) Each institution of higher education must develop a procedurefor receiving the necessary documentation to identify and verify themilitary training course or program that an individual is claiming foracademic credit. (3) Each institution of higher education must provide a copy of itspolicy for awarding academic credit for military training to anyenrolled student who listed prior or present military service in his orher application. Each institution of higher education must develop andmaintain a list of military training courses and programs that havequalified for academic credit. (4) Each institution of higher education must submit its policy forawarding academic credit for military training to the prior learningassessment work group convened pursuant to RCW 28B.77.230. The workgroup must evaluate each policy and make recommendations to eachinstitution.
